summary: The analyzed candidates primarily represent systemic health, renal function, and respiratory symptoms. Renal function markers (creatinine clearance and level), physical deconditioning, and diastolic blood pressure emerge as strong confounders and effect modifiers. COVID-19 status and medication use act primarily as effect modifiers. Cough-related features show mixed evidence, primarily serving as prognostic factors or weak effect modifiers. The consistency is highest for renal markers and general physical health indices.
